last.verdict: Celsius beat expectations on sales and profit, but Alani Nu is carrying growth while the flagship brand shrinks and margins keep falling.

takeaways.label: Beat, but with low bar
takeaways.text: Revenue of $847M and adjusted EPS of $0.41 topped analyst estimates of roughly $816M and $0.36, after last quarter's miss. Adjusted EPS was still below last year's $0.42.

takeaways.label: Alani Nu does the work
takeaways.text: Alani Nu sales rose 24% to $410M, while the flagship CELSIUS brand fell about 6% to $357M on product cuts, shipment timing and weak club-store sales.

takeaways.label: Margins keep shrinking
takeaways.text: Gross margin fell to 46.8% from 51.3% a year ago on aluminum and fuel costs and more sales through PepsiCo's distribution. Adjusted EBITDA slipped 3% despite 17% revenue growth.

takeaways.label: Management shake-up
takeaways.text: Celsius named new presidents for the CELSIUS brand and for Rockstar plus emerging brands, a move to fix the flagship's slide. International sales grew 78% to $41M.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
